registered.name: project_list
registered.description: List project file names and byte sizes only; never reads content. Use before selecting a file. Cannot list excluded credentials, dependencies or outside paths.

registered.name: project_read
registered.description: Read a UTF-8 line range from a file explicitly selected by the user; returns SHA-256 and line evidence. Listing a file does not authorize its content. Cannot read credentials, binary, outside files or run code.

registered.name: prepare_numeric_experiment
registered.description: Prepare the existing generated/Darcy mean-ridge experiment draft for a user's explicit numeric task. Does not run a job; execution uses the existing specification confirmation workflow. Cannot introduce new datasets or methods.

registered.name: csv_inspect
registered.description: Inspect an explicitly selected UTF-8 comma CSV: column names, types, missing counts, small categorical levels and data hash. No raw numeric observations or summary means. Does not fit or run an experiment.

registered.name: prepare_tabular_experiment
registered.description: Prepare a reviewable G2 experiment draft from inspected CSV. Independent groups use Welch; paired groups match by unit ID; prediction compares mean/OLS on fixed 60/20/20 split. Requires explicitly declared provenance, unit and sample basis; never invent these. No execution before confirmation. No unregistered parameters, categorical predictors, causal claims or time/cluster designs.

sampling_note.description: Copy the sample-size/data-availability basis verbatim from the user; do not invent a power calculation.

randomization_note.description: For observational/synthetic omit this field or use exactly not_applicable. For randomized data copy the user's actual randomization statement; never infer one.
